title: How Much Does Radio Advertising Cost in Cameroon? 2026 Price Guide
author: Slim Biz
excerpt: Wondering how much radio advertising costs in Cameroon? This complete 2026 price guide covers spot rates, production costs, and how to get the best value from your radio advertising budget.
body:
Radio advertising is one of the most powerful mass-reach advertising channels in Cameroon. But one of the most common questions businesses ask before starting a radio campaign is: how much does it cost? The answer depends on several factors — the station, the time slot, the duration of the spot, and the length of the campaign.

This guide gives you a clear breakdown of radio advertising costs in Cameroon in 2026 so you can plan your budget effectively.

Factors That Affect Radio Advertising Costs in Cameroon

Station Reach: National stations like CRTV Radio command higher rates than local or regional stations because they reach a larger audience. Major private stations in Douala and Yaoundé such as Equinoxe FM, Magic FM, Radio Balafon, and Amplitude FM have strong urban reach and competitive rates.

Time Slot: Prime time slots — morning drive (6am-9am) and evening drive (5pm-8pm) — attract the largest audiences and therefore the highest advertising rates. Daytime slots (9am-5pm) and overnight slots are significantly cheaper. For most campaigns targeting working adults, morning and evening prime time deliver the best results.

Spot Duration: Standard radio spots are 30 seconds or 60 seconds. A 30-second spot is cheaper but requires more frequency to be effective. A 60-second spot allows a more complete message.

Campaign Length: Weekly and monthly packages offer significant discounts compared to single-broadcast rates. A 4-week campaign with multiple daily broadcasts will cost considerably less per spot than individual bookings.

Radio Advertising Rate Guide for Cameroon 2026

The following are approximate rate ranges. Actual rates vary by station and are subject to negotiation.

Major national or regional station, prime time, 30 seconds: 50,000 to 150,000 FCFA per broadcast.

Major national or regional station, daytime, 30 seconds: 20,000 to 60,000 FCFA per broadcast.

Local city station, prime time, 30 seconds: 20,000 to 80,000 FCFA per broadcast.

Local city station, daytime, 30 seconds: 10,000 to 30,000 FCFA per broadcast.

For a meaningful campaign — minimum 3 broadcasts per day over 4 weeks on a major station — expect to budget between 1,500,000 and 5,000,000 FCFA for airtime alone.

Radio Spot Production Costs

Separate from airtime, you need to produce your radio commercial. Production involves writing the script, recording voice talent (in French and/or English), adding music and sound effects, and final mixing.

Production costs for a professional radio spot in Cameroon typically range from 50,000 to 250,000 FCFA depending on complexity, whether original music is created, and how many voice artists are used.

How to Get the Best Value from Your Radio Budget

Frequency matters more than reach in radio advertising. A listener needs to hear your message multiple times before it registers and drives action. Spreading your budget across too many stations with too few broadcasts per station is a common mistake. It is better to own a time slot on one or two stations than to appear rarely on many.

Negotiate packages rather than spot rates. Stations offer significantly better rates for committed campaign packages.
